snippet.title: ROCKBEASTS - Release Window & Demo Launch Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about ROCKBEASTS: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1445880/ROCKBEASTS/

ROCKBEASTS is a rock-and-roll management RPG where you guide a 90s grunge band from garage obscurity to stadium glory. We are happy to announce new cast members - Matthew Mercer and Sam Riegel from the highly acclaimed Critical Role and share our first public demo, where players can enjoy their performances firsthand. Coming January 2027 to Steam, PlayStation 5, XBOX Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2.

ROCKBEASTS Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1445880/ROCKBEASTS/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012232
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/rockbeasts/9p0vk67djf13

--

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
